name: jang-lecture-pptx-builder
description: Import a PDF or PPTX lecture, structure it with Gemini, add recognized images, and download an editable PowerPoint presentation.

scripts.check: node --check browser-compat.js && node --check file-picker-bootstrap.js && node --check app-loader.js && node --check app.js && node --check lecture-file.js && node --check lecture-validator.js && node --check pptx-output.js && node --check pptx-engine.js && node --check pptx-reader.js && node --check functions/api/extract.js && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check scripts/serve.mjs
scripts.unit: node --test tests/unit/image-mode-render-plan.test.mjs tests/unit/geometry-overflow.test.mjs tests/unit/csp-scan.test.mjs tests/unit/lecture-validator.test.mjs tests/unit/browser-compat.test.mjs tests/unit/preview-file-picker.test.mjs tests/unit/file-picker.test.mjs tests/unit/extract-function.test.mjs tests/unit/pptx-workflow.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run unit && npm run build
